title: Burford discusses legal disputes arising from Gulf shipping disruption in Lloyd’s List
summary: Burford discusses legal disputes arising from Gulf shipping disruption in Lloyd’s List. Learn more.
body_markdown:
[Christiane Deniger](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christiane-deniger/) and[Charlie Rooke](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/charlie-rooke/) examine the potential wave of commercial disputes arising from disruption in the Strait of Hormuz in an article for *Lloyd’s List* . They discuss the implications for shipping, energy and fertilizer markets, including force majeure, contractual disputes and insurance claims, and explain how legal finance can help businesses manage litigation costs, unlock liquidity and pursue recoveries.


Read the full article[here](https://www.lloydslist.com/LL1158896/Hundreds-of-ships-stranded-in-the-Gulf-The-legal-disputes-are-just-getting-started) .
